mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id AS "cartId" , c.member_id AS "memberId" , c.stock_id AS "stockId" , c.cart_quantity AS "cartQuantity" , c.cart_created_at AS "cartCreatedAt" , p.product_uid AS "productId" , p.product_name AS "productName" , p.product_price AS "productPrice" , p.product_discount AS "productDiscount" , p.gender AS "gender" , p.category_id AS "categoryId" , po.product_option_id AS "optionId" , po.product_color AS "optionColor" , po.product_size AS "optionSize" , po.product_quantity AS "optionQuantity" , img.image_path AS "thumbnailImg" FROM "cart" c FULL OUTER JOIN "product_tb" p ON c.stock_id = p.product_uid FULL OUTER JOIN "product_option_tb" po ON p.product_uid = po.product_option_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_uid) product_uid, image_path FROM product_image_tb WHERE image_path ILIKE '%.avif' ORDER BY product_uid, product_img_id ) img ON p.product_uid=img.product_uid WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.cart_created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "cart" (member_id, stock_id, cart_quantity, cart_created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{stockId}, #{quantity}, NOW())
